subject: Price velocity match and staged migration offer for HelixHealth
messages:
From: Maya Kline <maya.kline@helixhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask on pricing match + migration path

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the runtime performance looked promising. Procurement asked me to check whether Redwood can match an incumbent blended rate we have and what a staged migration would look like (we need low-risk cutover for our consumer-facing inference).

Specifics:
- Current vendor is charging an effective $0.0045/token on peak months (blended after discounts).
- We expect 25% month-on-month growth in token usage during the pilot.
- Key asks: a short credit/bridge for the first two months, a clear rollback window, and a phased plan so our infra team can validate performance mid-pilot.

Can you share a simple staged offer and any evidence on low-latency fallbacks? Attaching our internal scoring rubric separately (we can share via procurement).

Best,
Maya
Procurement, HelixHealth

Attachments: helix_rfp_scoring.xlsx (ref)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Kline <maya.kline@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask on pricing match + migration path

Maya — thanks for the clear ask and the rubric. High level: we can match the effective $0.0045/token for a staged pilot with a short-term bridge and a rollback safety net.

Summary proposal (preview):
- 8-week staged pilot: Weeks 1–2: 30% traffic (shadow + limited production), Weeks 3–6: 70% traffic, Weeks 7–8: full cutover validation.
- Price velocity match: effective $0.0045/token for the first two months (applied as credits) then standard usage pricing thereafter unless Helix commits to a 12-month reserved consumption at a blended rate.
- Bridge credits: $50k credit bucket applied to invoices during onboarding months to cover migration delta.
- Rollback: two-week rollback window with automated routing back to incumbent for in-flight sessions, plus runbook and pre-authorized egress-free reversal of routes.

I attached a short playbook and a price-velocity matrix that maps usage tiers to possible committed blends. Jonas and Vanessa — I copied you to confirm ops constraints and the credit mechanics.

Would you be available Wednesday for a 30-min procurement/infra alignment call?

Best,
Irene
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-staged-offer-HELIX-472.pdf, price-velocity-matrix.xlsx, helix_migration_playbook_v1.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: HelixHealth pricing match — input needed before Wed call

Team — forwarding Maya's ask and my preview. Quick points I need you to confirm before the Wednesday call (internal-only):

1) Ops/latency: Vanessa — can we commit to the two-week rollback automation across their us-west region? Any caveats with KV cache invalidation during rollback? If we need a manual window, call it out.

2) Economics: Markus — $50k bridge credit looks tight if they spike quickly. If we allow the match only for the first two months as credits, what guardrails should we set (e.g., cap per-day token throttles, minimum committed MRR to enable credits)?

3) Routing and fallbacks: Jonas — the plan includes shadowing for first 2 weeks and then canary. We need explicit fallthroughs: if average tail latency exceeds 350ms on 95p, route ~10% of affected requests back to incumbent automatically. Doable?

Proposed quick constraints: credit applied when they sign pilot SOW, credits expire after 90 days from application, daily usage cap of 1.5x baseline for pilot to avoid runaway credit consumption.

Reply inline please; I’ll stitch into the deck.

Thanks — Irene

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: HelixHealth pricing match — input needed before Wed call

Irene — quick replies inline: 

1) Ops/latency: We can automate rollback routing and preserve KV caches for a 5–10 minute warm-up. The caveat is that immediate swap may produce a short flurry of cache misses; recommend a staged rollback ramp (100% -> 60% -> 0% over 20 minutes) to smooth. We can instrument an alert if 95p tail crosses 350ms and start the ramp automatically.

2) Economics: Markus and I chatted; instead of a flat $50k bucket, propose a two-part structure: $30k onboarding credit + up to $40k performance-protection credit that only kicks in if their verified usage exceeds projections by >25% during pilot (helps limit our downside). Also add a per-day soft cap of 1.5x baseline and a hard cap at 2.5x unless pre-approved.

3) Routing/fallbacks: doable. We’ll wire a smart-policy that respects session affinity and falls back per request when latency thresholds are met. Need SE to approve the exact heuristics but technically feasible.

I can join the Wed call and walk the fallback visualization.

— Jonas

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Kline <maya.kline@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Staged migration offer and guardrails (HELIX-472)

Maya — thanks for the time today. Per our discussion, please find the formalized staged offer (summary below) and attached playbook + pricing matrix for your procurement review.

Offer summary (pilot SOW):
- Pilot length: 8 weeks (same cadence we discussed).
- Financials: $30k onboarding credit applied to month-1 invoice; up to $40k performance-protection credit (conditional) to be applied only if verified ramp >25% vs. baseline and approved by redwood ops; net effective tie-out to $0.0045/token for the first two months via credits.
- Usage guardrails: soft daily cap = 1.5x baseline; hard cap = 2.5x baseline (requires pre-approval to lift).
- Rollback & fallbacks: automatic staged rollback ramp (100% -> 60% -> 0% over 20 minutes) triggered if 95p tail latency > 350ms for 5 consecutive mins. Session-affinity preserved.
- Commit option: if Helix signs a 12-month consumption agreement within 30 days of pilot completion we will convert credits into a blended committed rate and apply an additional 5% volume discount on months 3–12.

Next steps:
1) Procurement — if the terms look OK, we’ll issue a pilot SOW and attach the credit mechanics.
2) Ops alignment — Jonas to schedule the runbook walkthrough with Helix infra (30–40 mins).
3) Legal — standard SOW and rollback clause; will be minimal redlines.

Attachments: redwood-staged-offer-HELIX-472.pdf (formal offer), price-velocity-matrix.xlsx (tier mapping), helix_migration_playbook_v1.pdf (ops runbook)

Happy to hop on a follow-up with procurement to finalize the SOW.

Best,
Irene
